name: Water butt
description: A coopered butt catching roof water from the eaves, kept against a rear or side wall of the yard for washing and the animals.

visual.look: Bulging coopered butt of twenty staves bound with split-hazel hoops, standing on two sleepers, open-topped and full of dark rainwater; an optional hollowed eaves channel drains into it.
